statement.zh: 碑铭与综合强调经典期低地为多政体竞争格局，而非单一帝国（Martin & Grube；Sharer & Traxler）。
statement.en: Epigraphy and syntheses emphasize Classic lowlands as multi-polity competition rather than a single empire (Martin & Grube; Sharer & Traxler).
